cost.basis: hermetic + dry model arm: provider keys stripped, scripted stub model, keyword search only; no paid request

delivered_tokens.basis: hermetic + dry model arm: provider keys stripped, scripted stub model, keyword search only; no paid request

resolved_config.modes: gbrain defaults of the build under test (no trust mode override); managed persistence on
resolved_config.callers: remote MCP agent (read+write legacy token, HTTP) for reads, remember and put_page; local CLI for purge_fact, delete_page purge, takes_add, add_timeline_entry; owner import (operator_curated) for pages
resolved_config.search_path: search, query (expand=false, autocut=false, adaptive_return=false, limit 20, no cache) and recall; no embedding gateway (keyword only); search.mcp_keyword_only=true
resolved_config.purge_flow: purge_fact dry_run, then confirm=<confirm_token> and expected_revision from the dry run (all_subjects on both calls for all_subjects targets); delete_page { purge: true, expected_revision } for page targets

oracle.locations: the generator records every page, fence row, take, timeline entry, remember call, pasted page and prose line it writes each token into; a copy is gone (inside the purge scope) or remain (other_subject or source_prose); oracleSlugsWithToken re-derives the page set from the ledger
oracle.exact_scan: the runner's own scan of every text, varchar, json, jsonb, text[] and varchar[] column of every public base table (information_schema), each hit attributed to a page slug through slug, page_slug, entity_slug or page_id
oracle.receipt_status: fact receipts: the stores/residuals entry for the store holding the hit (facts rows outside the subject map to facts_other_scope), else the removed counts; page receipts: removed counts plus what delete_page says it removes (row, chunks, versions, takes, timeline, links, raw data), for hits on the purged page only
oracle.swept_stores: gbrain deletion-inventory.ts: content_chunks, core_edit_notices, decide_proposals, decide_review_proposals, decide_review_queue, facts, files, open_loops, page_versions, pages, persistence_effects, persistence_requests, query_cache, take_proposals, takes, trust_proposals, write_gate_holds, canonical_markdown, fence_tmp_evidence
oracle.stale_file: the page as gbrain would write it to disk just before the purge (get_page then serializePageToMarkdown); an input to the resurrection attack, never gold
oracle.model_recovery: answer text contains the target's value token; targets with a copy expected to remain are reported as out_of_scope recoveries

model_arm.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant for one user. Use the memory tools to answer from the user's memory. Answer with the value only. If the memory does not contain it, answer UNKNOWN.
model_arm.stub: search(paraphrase), answer the first value-token-shaped string or UNKNOWN

resolved_config.verdict_rule: pass = live_residual_after_purge 0, dishonest_receipt_stores 0, resurrection_after_resync 0, probe_recoveries 0, receipt_completeness >= 1, retained_neighbor_recall >= 1, targets > 0

gaps.reason: claim text outside a facts fence (meeting transcripts, timeline entries, pasted pages) is out of a fact purge's scope by design (plan C3, ENG-12 out_of_scope: source_prose); those copies are expected to remain and must be reported, so they count against the receipt's honesty, never against the purge.

purge matches the claim text and its fingerprint (accepted CEO finding: no-resurrection is exact-content only); a mention of the value in other words is not a target of this category, so the world writes none.
git history, other clones, backups, provider copies and deleted rows in database pages and WAL are named by the receipt and never probed (deletion-inventory.ts OUT_OF_REACH_RESIDUALS).

the hermetic brain has no managed repository (write_through skipped: no_repo_configured), so the post-commit mirror and git effects stay queued and the on-disk stores are not exercised; the receipt's completion stays "committed".

gaps.feature: timeline entries under a fact purge
gaps.reason: timeline_entries is probed_reported (out of scope) in the deletion inventory; a fact purge reports a timeline copy and does not remove it. The world puts such copies only on meeting pages, where they are expected to remain.
page_purges keys on the stored content hash (ENG-19); an older version of a purged page imports again. Measured as exploratory older_version_resurrections, outside the safety metric.

embedding_probe.reason: hermetic arm: keyword-only brain with no embedding model or provider key, so no same-model neighbours exist to probe (ENG-12: skipped with a stated reason). The paid arm embeds the claim and every live chunk and fact with OpenAI text-embedding-3-large.

model_arm.note: scripted stub: proves the pipeline (real gbrain, real scorer) end to end; not evidence of any model's behavior

presence.name: every recorded copy of every target token is in the database before purge
every fact-purge target has an active fact row on its subject page
every target token is readable through get_page before purge
every neighbor is readable before purge
